faq.titleA: Answers to the questions we get
faq.lead: Is your question not listed? Feel free to call one of our stores or send a message through the contact page.
faq.q1: Where can I find the Schilperoort IJzerwaren stores?
faq.a1: We have two stores in Rijswijk. The Bogaard store is at Prins Johan Friso Promenade 150, 2284 DC Rijswijk. The Herenstraat store is at Herenstraat 72, 2282 BZ Rijswijk.
faq.a2: The opening hours per day for both stores are listed on the contact page. We are closed on Monday and we are closed on Sunday.
faq.q3: Can I have a key cut at your store?
faq.a3: Yes. We cut keys for your home, the letterbox, the safe, your bicycle, motorcycle and scooter. Car keys with a transponder are part of our key service as well.
faq.q4: Do you also cut car keys with a transponder?
faq.a4: Yes, car keys with a transponder are part of our key service. Bring your current key to the store and we will look at the options with you.
faq.q5: Which tool brands do you sell?
faq.a5: In our stores you will find tools and materials from brands such as Neo Tools, Topex, KWB, Verto and Deltafix.
faq.q6: Can I order from you online?
faq.a6: Name plates can be designed and ordered through our online ordering service. For everything else you are welcome in one of our two stores in Rijswijk.
faq.q7: How do I order a name plate?
faq.a7: Through our online ordering service you pick a model, add your own text and choose material, colour and finish. The ordering service runs on its own website.
faq.a8: Yes. We stock halogen lamps, led lamps, incandescent bulbs and fluorescent lighting. Bring the old lamp or the fitting with you and we will look at which replacement fits.
faq.q9: Do you have vacuum cleaner bags that fit my vacuum cleaner?
faq.a9: Vacuum cleaner bags are part of our range. Bring your old bag or the type number of your vacuum cleaner to the store and we will find the right size.
faq.q10: Are the stores closed during the holidays?
faq.a10: A holiday closure is planned for the Herenstraat store from 18 up to and including 26 September 2026. The store reopens on 29 September 2026. Dates may change, so feel free to call ahead.
faq.ctaText: Just ask it. You can call, you can drop by, and through the form on the contact page you can type out your question at your own pace.

privacy.title: Privacy statement
privacy.p2: The contact form on this website opens your own email program with a ready made message. The details you fill in therefore reach us as an ordinary email, without a third party in between. It concerns:
privacy.li3: Your phone number, if you fill it in
privacy.p3: We only use your data to answer your question and to get back to you about your message. We do not sell your data and we do not use it for advertising.
privacy.p4: We do not keep your message longer than needed to handle your question. In most cases that is a maximum of twelve months after the last contact.
privacy.p5: This website uses the following services:
privacy.li5: GitHub Pages for hosting this website
privacy.li6: Google Fonts for loading the typefaces, which means your IP address is passed on to Google
privacy.li7: An external ordering service for name plates, which has its own privacy policy
privacy.h6: Cookies and storage in your browser
privacy.p6: This website places no advertising cookies and does not track your behaviour. Your browser does store which language you picked and whether you dismissed the notice at the bottom of the screen. That data stays on your own device.
privacy.p7: You have the right to view your data, to have it corrected or to have it deleted. You can also object to the processing. Send an email to the store you have been in contact with.
privacy.p8: If you believe we are not processing your personal data properly, you can file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
